lines.text: DET notes: Detroit gets rim protectiona cross the lineup, with Kevin Huerter tying his career high with five blocks on Nov. 8 against the Lakers, and John Collins, Paul Reed and Huerter are all averaging close to a block a game.

ORL notes — Franz Wagner: T-4th in NBA · As of Nov. 24, ranks fourth in the NBA in minutes played, tied for fifth in assists, tied for 15th in scoring, tied for 37th in rebounding and tied for 38th in steals.

Ausar Thompson is shooting 72.7% on free throws this season (24-for-33), against 60.0% over his career before it (452 attempts): 12.8 points above his own rate, the furthest above among the 123 players with 30+ attempts

BOS notes: 6th in NBA · Jayson Tatum currently ranks 6th in the NBA in points per game (26.4) and 14th in assists per game (6.7).
